sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.

sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是迈克尔。

sentences.en: For the past four years, I've hosted this show, pretty much without fail, five days a week, and I'm not going anywhere.
sentences.zh: 在过去的四年里，我几乎从未间断地主持这个节目，每周五天，我哪儿也不会去。

sentences.en: But I had a baby, so for the next few months, I won't be working every day, giving you a chance to hear from a broader set of voices within the show,
sentences.zh: 但我有了个孩子，所以接下来的几个月里，我不会每天工作，这让你们有机会听到节目中更多不同的声音，

sentences.en: including Asted Herndon, Sabrina Tavernisi, and Kevin Roos.
sentences.zh: 包括阿斯特德·赫恩登、萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西和凯文·鲁斯。

sentences.en: My thanks to our guest hosts, The Daily Team, and as always, to you for listening.
sentences.zh: 感谢我们的客座主持、《每日新闻》团队，也一如既往地感谢你们的收听。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is A Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今日话题。

sentences.en: The story of Ryanair Flight 4978.
sentences.zh: 瑞安航空4978号航班的故事。

sentences.en: Sabrina Tavernisi spoke with our colleague, Anton Troianovsky, about why the leader of Belarus forced the plane to land, the passenger he was after, and what may happen next.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西与我们的同事安东·特罗亚诺夫斯基探讨了白俄罗斯领导人为何强迫该飞机降落、他针对的是哪位乘客，以及接下来可能会发生什么。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, May 27th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月27日，星期四。

sentences.en: Anton.
sentences.zh: 安东。

sentences.en: Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: With the story of this plane in Belarus.
sentences.zh: 关于白俄罗斯这架飞机的故事。

sentences.en: Tell me what happened inside the plane.
sentences.zh: 告诉我飞机里发生了什么。

sentences.en: Start from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 从头说起。

sentences.en: So this is Sunday.
sentences.zh: 那是周日。

sentences.en: It's a typical European low-cost flight operated by the Irish-based airline Ryanair from Athens to Vilnius, the capital of Lithuania,
sentences.zh: 这是一架典型的欧洲廉价航空航班，由爱尔兰瑞安航空公司运营，从雅典飞往立陶宛首都维尔纽斯，

sentences.en: with more than 120 passengers on board from all over Europe, as well as U.S.
sentences.zh: 机上载有来自欧洲各地以及美国的120多名乘客。

sentences.en: citizens.
sentences.zh: 公民。

sentences.en: And toward the end of the flight, as the plane is flying over Belarus, the pilot gets radioed from Belarusian air traffic control.
sentences.zh: 在飞行快结束时，当飞机飞越白俄罗斯上空，飞行员收到了白俄罗斯空中交通管制的无线电呼叫。

sentences.en: And a Belarusian air traffic controller tells him,
sentences.zh: 一名白俄罗斯空管人员告诉他，

sentences.en: there's a bomb threat to your plane.
sentences.zh: 你的飞机受到了炸弹威胁。

sentences.en: We recommend you turn around and land in Minsk.
sentences.zh: 我们建议你掉头并在明斯克降落。

sentences.en: Minsk being the capital of Belarus.
sentences.zh: 明斯克是白俄罗斯的首都。

sentences.en: The pilots, from what we know, aren't sure at first what to do.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，飞行员起初并不确定该怎么做。

sentences.en: You know, it's also a bit unusual that the air traffic control of a country that's neither the departure point nor the destination of the flight
sentences.zh: 要知道，一个既不是出发地也不是目的地的国家的空管部门

sentences.en: would be informing you about a bomb threat.
sentences.zh: 通知你炸弹威胁，这确实有点不同寻常。

sentences.en: It's very strange.
sentences.zh: 这非常奇怪。

sentences.en: It's very strange.
sentences.zh: 这非常奇怪。

sentences.en: And the pilots actually get in touch with Ryanair operations on the ground, according to Lithuanian investigators, and ask them what to do.
sentences.zh: 据立陶宛调查人员称，飞行员实际上联系了地面的瑞安航空运营部门，询问该怎么做。

sentences.en: And then they eventually agree to go back to Minsk, even though at this point they're closer to the city of Vilnius than they are to the Belarusian capital.
sentences.zh: 最终他们同意返回明斯克，尽管此时他们距离维尔纽斯比距离白俄罗斯首都更近。

sentences.en: As this is happening, a fighter jet takes off from a Belarusian air force base and heads toward the plane.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，一架战斗机从白俄罗斯空军基地起飞，朝飞机飞去。

sentences.en: We don't know yet how close that Belarusian fighter jet got, but we know there was a fighter jet scramble to escort this plane back to Minsk.
sentences.zh: 我们还不知道那架白俄罗斯战斗机靠近到了什么程度，但我们知道确实有战斗机紧急升空，护送这架飞机返回明斯克。

sentences.en: A fighter jet, my God.
sentences.zh: 战斗机，天哪。

sentences.en: What do the passengers know about what's going on this whole time?
sentences.zh: 在此期间，乘客们对发生的事情了解多少？

sentences.en: They don't know anything at firSt.
sentences.zh: 起初他们一无所知。

sentences.en: During all the flights, the flight was normal.
sentences.zh: 在整个飞行过程中，飞行都很正常。

sentences.en: Passengers later would talk about what they remembered.
sentences.zh: 乘客们后来谈到了他们的记忆。

sentences.en: I mean, like I said, this was a regular flight.
sentences.zh: 我是说，就像我说的，这是一次常规飞行。

sentences.en: The process of getting ready for landing had already begun.
sentences.zh: 准备降落的过程已经开始了。

sentences.en: At one moment, we just change the direction of flight and we go down and to the left.
sentences.zh: 突然间，我们改变了飞行方向，开始下降并向左转。

sentences.en: And then suddenly this plane makes a really sharp turn, a U-turn, a kind of turn that passengers on commercial flights don't normally experience.
sentences.zh: 然后这架飞机突然做了一个非常急的转弯，一个U型转弯，这是商业航班乘客通常不会经历的那种转弯。

sentences.en: And they weren't given a clear explanation as to what was going on from what we understand.
sentences.zh: 据我们了解，他们没有得到关于发生了什么的明确解释。

sentences.en: And then about 15 minutes later...
sentences.zh: 大约15分钟后……

sentences.en: We received the announcement from the captain saying, oh, we received a call from the Belarusian airport saying that...
sentences.zh: 我们收到了机长的广播，说哦，我们收到了白俄罗斯机场的电话，说……

sentences.en: The pilot comes on the intercom and says, the plane is being diverted to Minsk.
sentences.zh: 飞行员通过对讲机说，飞机正在改道前往明斯克。

sentences.en: Now, many passengers still don't really know what to make of this, but then there's one passenger on board who clearly does know what's going on.
sentences.zh: 现在，许多乘客仍然不知道这意味着什么，但机上有一名乘客显然很清楚发生了什么。

sentences.en: There's a young man who, according to what passengers recall, suddenly becomes frightened, even panicked.
sentences.zh: 据乘客回忆，有一名年轻人突然变得惊恐，甚至陷入恐慌。

sentences.en: Some passengers recall he's actually getting his laptop and his phone and giving it to the young woman he's traveling with.
sentences.zh: 一些乘客回忆说，他实际上拿出了笔记本电脑和手机，交给了与他同行的年轻女子。

sentences.en: One passenger asks him, what's going on?
sentences.zh: 一名乘客问他，发生了什么事？

sentences.en: And according to several people on the plane, he responds, the death penalty awaits me in Belarus.
sentences.zh: 据机上几个人说，他回答道，白俄罗斯在等着判我死刑。

sentences.en: Whoa.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So who is this guy, Anton?
sentences.zh: 那么这家伙是谁，安东？

sentences.en: His name is Roman Protasevich.
sentences.zh: 他叫罗曼·普罗塔塞维奇。

sentences.en: He's 26 years old.
sentences.zh: 他今年26岁。

sentences.en: He's a dissident journalist from Belarus who's been living in exile since 2019.
sentences.zh: 他是一位白俄罗斯持不同政见记者，自2019年以来一直流亡在外。

sentences.en: And the Belarusian state considers him one of its biggest enemies.
sentences.zh: 白俄罗斯政府视他为最大的敌人之一。

sentences.en: So, Anton, you have this dissident who's just really panicking on this flight.
sentences.zh: 所以，安东，这名持不同政见者在飞机上非常恐慌。

sentences.en: And the plane has just made this incredibly sharp U-turn.
sentences.zh: 而飞机刚刚做了一个极其剧烈的U型转弯。

sentences.en: No one knows what's going on except for the dissident.
sentences.zh: 除了这名持不同政见者，没人知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: So what happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: So, eventually, the plane lands at the Minsk airport.
sentences.zh: 最终，飞机降落在明斯克机场。

sentences.en: So after 15 minutes after all this procedure, we land into Minsk.
sentences.zh: 在经历了这一切程序15分钟后，我们降落在明斯克。

sentences.en: It taxis to a section of the tarmac away from the terminal.
sentences.zh: 它滑行到了远离航站楼的停机坪区域。

sentences.en: And we have seen a lot of stuff from Belarusia.
sentences.zh: 我们从白俄罗斯看到了很多东西。

sentences.en: It was like fire machines and police machines.
sentences.zh: 就像消防车和警车一样。

sentences.en: It's surrounded by soldiers, by airport workers, by officials with bomb-sniffing dogs.
sentences.zh: 周围都是士兵、机场工作人员和带着搜爆犬的官员。

sentences.en: And then for half an hour or so, no one is allowed to get off the plane.
sentences.zh: 然后大约半小时内，没人被允许下飞机。

sentences.en: So, at that point, passengers are thinking, if this really is a bomb threat, it's certainly strange that we're not being taken off the plane immediately.
sentences.zh: 所以，在那一刻，乘客们心想，如果这真的是炸弹威胁，我们没有立即被疏散确实很奇怪。

sentences.en: Then the passengers are taken off the plane in groups of five.
sentences.zh: 然后乘客们被分批带下飞机，每组五人。

sentences.en: Their luggage is spread out on the tarmac in kind of a grid pattern.
sentences.zh: 他们的行李在停机坪上呈网格状摊开。

sentences.en: They have a bomb-sniffing dog go through all of it.
sentences.zh: 他们让搜爆犬检查了所有行李。

sentences.en: And there's soldiers in green camouflage, bulletproof vests, helmets, overseeing this rather odd scene.
sentences.zh: 身穿绿色迷彩服、防弹背心、戴着头盔的士兵在监督这相当奇怪的一幕。

sentences.en: And then the passengers see Protasevich and his girlfriend, who's traveling with him, being taken away to the terminal by security officials.
sentences.zh: 然后乘客们看到普罗塔塞维奇和与他同行的女友被安全官员带往航站楼。

sentences.en: And that's the last that they saw of him.
sentences.zh: 那是他们最后一次见到他。

sentences.en: So do they actually find a bomb?
sentences.zh: 那么他们真的找到了炸弹吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: No, they don't find a bomb.
sentences.zh: 不，他们没找到炸弹。

sentences.en: The Belarusian government comes out pretty soon saying that this was a false bomb threat and that they're investigating even where this bomb threat came from.
sentences.zh: 白俄罗斯政府很快出来表示，这是一个虚假的炸弹威胁，他们正在调查炸弹威胁的来源。

sentences.en: But as news of Protasevich's arrest spreads through social media, it becomes very clear to everyone what this was actually about.
sentences.zh: 但随着普罗塔塞维奇被捕的消息在社交媒体上传开，每个人都很清楚这到底是怎么回事。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能访问所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《纽约时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《纽约时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载该应用，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Anton, the story of what happened to this Ryanair flight is incredibly strange.
sentences.zh: 所以，安东，这架瑞安航空航班发生的故事极其离奇。

sentences.en: I mean, it's a commercial flight.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这是一次商业飞行。

sentences.en: It's two European capitals it's flying between.
sentences.zh: 它是在两个欧洲首都之间飞行。

sentences.en: And then suddenly it makes a U-turn.
sentences.zh: 然后突然做了一个U型转弯。

sentences.en: There's a fighter jet outside.
sentences.zh: 外面有一架战斗机。

sentences.en: And it all looks, in retrospect, that this was just a big ploy to get this dissident.
sentences.zh: 回想起来，这一切看起来都只是为了抓住这个持不同政见者的大阴谋。

sentences.en: It had nothing to do with a bomb.
sentences.zh: 这与炸弹毫无关系。

sentences.en: So why would Belarus go through all this trouble to get this guy?
sentences.zh: 那么白俄罗斯为什么要费这么大劲去抓这个人呢？

sentences.en: Well, you really have to go back to even to the 90s to answer that question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，要回答这个问题，你真的得追溯到90年代。

sentences.en: Belarus is a former Soviet republic in Eastern Europe between Russia and the European Union.
sentences.zh: 白俄罗斯是东欧的一个前苏联加盟共和国，位于俄罗斯和欧盟之间。

sentences.en: It's been run since 1994 by an authoritarian leader named Alexander Lukashenko.
sentences.zh: 自1994年以来，它一直由一位名叫亚历山大·卢卡申科的威权领导人统治。

sentences.en: He's been called Europe's last dictator, and he's actually embraced that title.
sentences.zh: 他被称为欧洲最后的独裁者，而且他实际上欣然接受了这个称号。

sentences.en: Last summer, he claimed victory after a fraudulent election that sparked protests across the country.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天，他在一场引发全国抗议的欺诈性选举后宣称获胜。

sentences.en: Unprecedented outrage over an election demonstrators say was stolen.
sentences.zh: 示威者称选举被窃取，对此感到前所未有的愤怒。

sentences.en: By the president, they're demanding step down.
sentences.zh: 他们要求总统下台。

sentences.en: Over my dead body, says Alexander Lukashenko.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大·卢卡申科说，除非我死，否则绝不可能。

sentences.en: Hundreds of thousands of people came out demanding that Lukashenko resign.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的人走上街头，要求卢卡申科辞职。

sentences.en: Lukashenko's refusal to step down has set the stage for a showdown with protesters who say they have nothing left to lose.
sentences.zh: 卢卡申科拒绝下台，这为与那些声称已无所失去的抗议者之间的摊牌奠定了基础。

sentences.en: I remember those protests.
sentences.zh: 我记得那些抗议活动。

sentences.en: It was all of these people in public squares and their flags and posting videos on social media.
sentences.zh: 到处都是公共广场上的人群，挥舞着旗帜，在社交媒体上发布视频。

sentences.en: And I remember thinking, wow, is this guy about to lose power?
sentences.zh: 我记得当时想，哇，这家伙要失去权力了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it was a remarkable moment for a post-Soviet country.
sentences.zh: 是的，对于一个后苏联国家来说，这是一个非凡的时刻。

sentences.en: The white, red, white flags of the opposition were everywhere.
sentences.zh: 反对派的白-红-白旗帜随处可见。

sentences.en: Women were coming out dressed all in white and with white flowers lining up in memory of the protesters who had died.
sentences.zh: 妇女们身穿全白服装，手持白花，排成一列，以纪念那些死去的抗议者。

sentences.en: And those protests were organized and galvanized in large part by an account on the social network Telegram
sentences.zh: 而这些抗议活动在很大程度上是由社交网络Telegram上的一个账号组织和推动的，

sentences.en: that this guy on the airplane, Protasevich, was helping run out of Warsaw.
sentences.zh: 飞机上的那个家伙普罗塔塞维奇一直在华沙帮助运营这个账号。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And this particular channel that Protasevich was helping run had more than 2 million followers at the height of the protests.
sentences.zh: 普罗塔塞维奇参与运营的这个特定频道在抗议活动高峰期拥有超过200万粉丝。

sentences.en: And this is in a country of 9 million people.
sentences.zh: 而这还是在一个只有900万人口的国家。

sentences.en: Wow, that's a huge number.
sentences.zh: 哇，那是一个巨大的数字。

sentences.en: It's a huge number.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的数字。

sentences.en: And this Telegram account was constantly sharing information about the injustices of the Lukashenko regime.
sentences.zh: 这个Telegram账号不断分享关于卢卡申科政权不公正行为的信息。

sentences.en: And it was also literally organizing the protests, saying where should people go at what time, even giving advice on how to resist the police.
sentences.zh: 它甚至在字面上组织抗议活动，告诉人们应该在什么时间去哪里，甚至提供如何抵制警察的建议。

sentences.en: So this Telegram account played a really big role, and that really explains why, for Lukashenko, Protasevich was an enemy of the state.
sentences.zh: 所以这个Telegram账号发挥了非常大的作用，这确实解释了为什么对于卢卡申科来说，普罗塔塞维奇是国家的敌人。

sentences.en: And, of course, those protests happened in August and September, but Lukashenko was able to hold on.
sentences.zh: 当然，那些抗议活动发生在8月和9月，但卢卡申科还是坚持了下来。

sentences.en: And he responded to those protests with really extraordinary repression.
sentences.zh: 他对这些抗议活动进行了非常严厉的镇压。

sentences.en: Many thousands of Belarusians were jailed.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的白俄罗斯人被关进监狱。

sentences.en: There's been dissidents who have died in prison in strange circumstances.
sentences.zh: 有一些持不同政见者在监狱中死于离奇的情况。

sentences.en: And Belarus was already an authoritarian state for years, but it became even more so an authoritarian state in these last months.
sentences.zh: 白俄罗斯多年来一直是一个威权国家，但在过去的几个月里，它变得更加威权了。

sentences.en: And you now have this exiled community of dissidents who are based in Lithuania, in Poland, in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 现在你有了这个流亡的持不同政见者群体，他们以立陶宛、波兰、乌克兰为基地。

sentences.en: Among them is Protasevich.
sentences.zh: 其中就包括普罗塔塞维奇。

sentences.en: He's even been put on a terrorist watch list by the Belarus Intelligence Service.
sentences.zh: 他甚至被白俄罗斯情报部门列入了恐怖分子观察名单。

sentences.en: So you can see that he in particular has a target on his back.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以看出，他本人确实成为了目标。

sentences.en: Okay, so now I think I understand a little bit better why the Belarusian state would bring down this plane and detain Protasevich.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在我想我稍微理解了为什么白俄罗斯政府会迫使这架飞机降落并拘留普罗塔塞维奇。

sentences.en: So Lukashenko goes through all this trouble.
sentences.zh: 所以卢卡申科费了这么大劲。

sentences.en: The plane comes down.
sentences.zh: 飞机降落了。

sentences.en: How does the international community react?
sentences.zh: 国际社会作何反应？

sentences.en: At first, it was just shock.
sentences.zh: 起初，只有震惊。

sentences.en: You know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，

sentences.en: the idea that a Boeing 737 commercial airliner flying between two EU capitals could be brought down in order for a dissident aboard to be arrested was not really something that I think a lot of people had imagined would be possible.
sentences.zh: 一架波音737客机在两个欧盟成员国首都之间飞行时，竟会被迫降以逮捕机上的异见人士，我认为很多人此前根本没想过这种事会发生。

sentences.en: Western governments have called it air piracy and state terrorism.
sentences.zh: 西方各国政府称其为空中海盗行为和国家恐怖主义。

sentences.en: The Greeks called it a state hijacking.
sentences.zh: 希腊方面称之为国家劫机事件。

sentences.en: An unprecedented act of state terrorism.
sentences.zh: 这是史无前例的国家恐怖主义行径。

sentences.en: The prime minister of Poland called it an act of state terrorism.
sentences.zh: 波兰总理称其为国家恐怖主义行为。

sentences.en: Roman Protasevich must sofort wieder freigelassen werden.
sentences.zh: 罗曼·普罗塔塞维奇必须立即获释。

sentences.en: You had Germany and France, obviously the most influential countries in the EU.
sentences.zh: 德国和法国显然是欧盟最具影响力的国家。

sentences.en: Cet act inacceptable, cette violation du droit international.
sentences.zh: 这是不可接受的行为，是对国际法的践踏。

sentences.en: Promising that there would be consequences.
sentences.zh: 并承诺将会有相应的后果。

sentences.en: Une réaction la plus ferme possible.
sentences.zh: 必须做出最强有力的回应。

sentences.en: And then Monday night, we have a regularly scheduled meeting of EU leaders in Brussels.
sentences.zh: 周一晚上，欧盟领导人在布鲁塞尔举行了例行会议。

sentences.en: Madame President, you have the floor.
sentences.zh: 主席女士，请发言。

sentences.en: Yes, thank you.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: So the president of the EU commission, Ursula von der Leyen, comes to the podium.
sentences.zh: 于是，欧盟委员会主席乌尔苏拉·冯德莱恩走上讲台。

sentences.en: Belarus used its control over its airspace in order to perpetrate a state hijacking.
sentences.zh: 白俄罗斯利用其对领空的控制权实施了国家劫机。

sentences.en: It starts by condemning Belarus for what happened on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 她首先谴责了白俄罗斯周日发生的行径。

sentences.en: Therefore, the safety and security of flights through Belarus airspace can no longer be trusted.
sentences.zh: 因此，飞越白俄罗斯领空的航班安全已不再值得信任。

sentences.en: And the council will adapt measures to ban overflies of the EU airspace.
sentences.zh: 理事会将采取措施，禁止飞机飞越欧盟领空。

sentences.en: And she also called on all EU-based airlines to stop flying over Belarus.
sentences.zh: 她还呼吁所有欧盟航空公司停止飞越白俄罗斯上空。

sentences.en: She called on EU airports not to accept planes from Belarus.
sentences.zh: 她呼吁欧盟各机场拒绝接收来自白俄罗斯的飞机。

sentences.en: So essentially cutting Belarus's direct air links with Western Europe.
sentences.zh: 这基本上切断了白俄罗斯与西欧的直接空中联系。

sentences.en: This is an attack on democracy.
sentences.zh: 这是对民主的攻击。

sentences.en: This is an attack on freedom of expression.
sentences.zh: 这是对言论自由的攻击。

sentences.en: And this is an attack on European sovereignty.
sentences.zh: 这是对欧洲主权的攻击。

sentences.en: What does that mean for Belarusians?
sentences.zh: 这对白俄罗斯人意味着什么？

sentences.en: Well, it may not sound like much, but it's actually a big deal.
sentences.zh: 嗯，听起来可能没什么，但实际上影响很大。

sentences.en: Ukraine, which is Belarus's southern neighbor, also went along with the flight ban.
sentences.zh: 白俄罗斯的南部邻国乌克兰也加入了禁飞行列。

sentences.en: The land borders are also largely closed right now because of COVID.
sentences.zh: 由于新冠疫情，陆路边境目前也基本处于关闭状态。

sentences.en: And that means that this country that, if you look on a map, is in the middle of Europe, is now disconnected from Europe by and large.
sentences.zh: 这意味着这个在地图上看位于欧洲中心的国家，现在基本上与欧洲隔绝了。

sentences.en: And so this is a country where there are so many families that have friends and relatives living abroad.
sentences.zh: 在这个国家，有太多的家庭在国外有亲朋好友。

sentences.en: At this point, they essentially can't get out of their country unless they go east and go through Russia, which is lengthy and costly.
sentences.zh: 目前，他们基本上无法离开自己的国家，除非向东经过俄罗斯，但这既费时又昂贵。

sentences.en: But looking at this from the outside, the flight ban feels like a step that very much affects ordinary citizens,
sentences.zh: 但从外部来看，禁飞令似乎是一个非常影响普通公民的举措，

sentences.en: who I imagine have no responsibility for what happened this weekend.
sentences.zh: 我想他们对这个周末发生的事情毫无责任。

sentences.en: So what else could the international community do to punish Lukashenko?
sentences.zh: 那么国际社会还能做些什么来惩罚卢卡申科呢？

sentences.en: I'm thinking about, you know, harsher types of economic sanctions, say, banning EU companies from doing business in Belarus, things like that.
sentences.zh: 我在想，比如更严厉的经济制裁，比如禁止欧盟公司在白俄罗斯开展业务之类的。

sentences.en: Well, there are already sanctions that the EU imposed last year on Lukashenko and others in the ruling elite in Belarus in response to the protests and the way they were repressed.
sentences.zh: 欧盟去年已经针对卢卡申科及白俄罗斯统治精英中的其他人实施了制裁，以回应抗议活动及其受到的镇压。

sentences.en: But the opposition to Lukashenko is now calling for more sanctions, for stronger ones,
sentences.zh: 但卢卡申科的反对派现在呼吁实施更多、更强有力的制裁，

sentences.en: including ones that would hit state-owned companies and more directly hit the economic interests of people in the ruling elite in Belarus.
sentences.zh: 包括打击国有企业，以及更直接地打击白俄罗斯统治精英的经济利益。

sentences.en: But there's a risk that these sanctions could push Belarus into an even more authoritarian direction, that they could isolate Belarus even more from the West,
sentences.zh: 但存在一种风险，即这些制裁可能会将白俄罗斯推向更专制的方向，使其与西方进一步隔绝，

sentences.en: and that they could push it even closer to its biggest ally, Russia.
sentences.zh: 并可能将其推向其最大的盟友俄罗斯。

sentences.en: Russia, right.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯，没错。

sentences.en: So how does Russia fit in here?
sentences.zh: 那么俄罗斯在这里扮演什么角色？

sentences.en: Well, Russia is in the background of essentially everything that happens in Belarus.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯基本上是白俄罗斯发生的一切背后的推手。

sentences.en: Russia is Belarus' biggest ally.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯是白俄罗斯最大的盟友。

sentences.en: It's its biggest trading partner.
sentences.zh: 它是其最大的贸易伙伴。

sentences.en: It's its biggest neighbor to the EaSt.
sentences.zh: 它是其东部最大的邻国。

sentences.en: And the two countries have a really symbiotic relationship where, for Lukashenko, Russia is the most important source of oil and gas at a cheap price as well as financing.
sentences.zh: 两国有着真正的共生关系，对卢卡申科而言，俄罗斯是廉价石油、天然气以及资金的最重要来源。

sentences.en: While for Putin, Belarus is really important because Putin sees Russia as being encroached upon by an aggressive and expanding NATO.
sentences.zh: 而对普京来说，白俄罗斯非常重要，因为普京认为俄罗斯正受到咄咄逼人且不断扩张的北约的蚕食。

sentences.en: And Belarus is kind of this last buffer between Russia and the West, protecting Russia's interests in Europe.
sentences.zh: 白俄罗斯就像是俄罗斯与西方之间的最后一道缓冲地带，保护着俄罗斯在欧洲的利益。

sentences.en: Okay, so Anton, I think I understand this.
sentences.zh: 好的，安东，我想我明白了。

sentences.en: The EU is in a kind of difficult spot because if it isolates Belarus too much, then that effectively pushes Belarus more toward Russia,
sentences.zh: 欧盟处于一种尴尬的境地，因为如果过度孤立白俄罗斯，实际上会把白俄罗斯推向俄罗斯，

sentences.en: which is something that they don't want to do because they would much rather see less Russian influence in the region.
sentences.zh: 这是他们不愿看到的，因为他们更希望该地区的俄罗斯影响力减弱。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so although the EU has imposed this flight ban and they have said that they want to impose further sanctions,
sentences.zh: 尽管欧盟实施了禁飞令，并表示希望实施进一步制裁，

sentences.en: they haven't yet implemented new financial sanctions against Belarusian individuals or companies.
sentences.zh: 但他们尚未对白俄罗斯个人或公司实施新的金融制裁。

sentences.en: So Anton, after everything that's happened over the past few days, you know, this brazen move to arrest Pratisevich by Belarus,
sentences.zh: 那么安东，在过去几天发生的一切之后，你知道，白俄罗斯这次逮捕普罗塔塞维奇的鲁莽举动，

sentences.en: the difficult place the EU is in and deciding how to respond to that.
sentences.zh: 以及欧盟在决定如何应对时所处的困境。

sentences.en: What do you take away from all of this?
sentences.zh: 你对此有什么看法？

sentences.en: Well, you really get the sense of how these international norms that we take for granted are continuing to be eroded.
sentences.zh: 你真的会感觉到我们视为理所当然的国际准则正在不断受到侵蚀。

sentences.en: You know, when you get on a plane on an international flight,
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你登上国际航班时，

sentences.en: you don't expect a country that happens to be in your flight path 30,000 feet below you to bring that plane down because someone else on board happens to be a dissident that's wanted in that country.
sentences.zh: 你绝不会想到，在你下方3万英尺处恰好经过某个国家的领空时，对方会因为机上有他们通缉的异见人士而强迫飞机降落。

sentences.en: That's just not something that's ever crossed my mind when I've flown internationally.
sentences.zh: 这在我出国飞行时从未想过。

sentences.en: And I think at least here in Eastern Europe and probably around the world, this is now going to be something that is more on people's minds.
sentences.zh: 我认为至少在东欧，甚至可能在全世界，这现在会成为人们更加关注的事情。

sentences.en: There are obviously countries all over the world that would be interested in tracking down a dissident who's living somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 显然，世界各地都有国家会对追踪身处他国的异见人士感兴趣。

sentences.en: So in a world that really depends on international commerce, that depends on the ease of international travel,
sentences.zh: 因此，在一个真正依赖国际贸易、依赖国际旅行便利的世界里，

sentences.en: situations like this can undermine a whole range of things in the way the world works.
sentences.zh: 像这样的情况可能会破坏世界运作方式中的一系列事物。

sentences.en: And what about the dissident in the middle of all of this, the guy from the plane, Pratisevich?
sentences.zh: 那么处于这一切中心的那个异见人士，那个从飞机上被带走的人，普罗塔塞维奇呢？

sentences.en: Do we know what happened to him after he was taken off the plane?
sentences.zh: 我们知道他被带下飞机后发生了什么吗？

sentences.en: Do we know if he's OK?
sentences.zh: 我们知道他是否安好吗？

sentences.en: So we didn't hear anything from him for 24 hours or so.
sentences.zh: 我们大概有24小时没有收到他的任何消息。

sentences.en: He didn't get access to lawyers.
sentences.zh: 他没有获得律师的帮助。

sentences.en: And then on Monday night, a video appears online, a 29-second video.
sentences.zh: 然后周一晚上，网上出现了一段视频，一段29秒的视频。

sentences.en: Of Pratisevich sitting in jail at a wooden table with a pack of cigarettes, saying that his health is OK,
sentences.zh: 视频中普罗塔塞维奇坐在监狱的木桌旁，放着一包香烟，说他的健康状况良好，

sentences.en: that he's being treated well and that he is giving confessional testimony in the criminal case against him for stirring mass unrest in Belarus last summer.
sentences.zh: 他受到了良好的对待，并且正在就去年夏天在白俄罗斯煽动大规模骚乱的刑事案件供认不讳。

sentences.en: This was a type of video that has actually become rather common in Belarus over the last year,
sentences.zh: 这种视频在过去一年里的白俄罗斯实际上已经变得相当普遍，

sentences.en: which is these confessional videos that the security services have been forcing dissident detainees to record while in jail.
sentences.zh: 也就是安全部门强迫被拘留的异见人士在狱中录制的认罪视频。

sentences.en: To me, he looked just shocked and exhausted.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，他看起来只是震惊和疲惫。

sentences.en: But there were people who said it looked like he had some kind of makeup on, potentially hiding bruises.
sentences.zh: 但有人说他看起来像是化了妆，可能是在掩盖淤青。

sentences.en: There was no way to determine for sure.
sentences.zh: 无法确定真伪。

sentences.en: But it was clear that this was a man who was speaking under duress, under the control of the Belarusian security services in the central detention center of Minsk.
sentences.zh: 但很明显，这是一个在胁迫下说话的人，是在明斯克中央拘留中心受白俄罗斯安全部门控制的人。

sentences.en: So we know that he was alive as of Monday.
sentences.zh: 所以我们知道截至周一他还活着。

sentences.en: But beyond that, given the sort of black hole that these Belarusian detention centers are,
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，考虑到白俄罗斯拘留中心那种黑洞般的性质，

sentences.en: there's almost nothing that we can say now about his condition or what kind of future he faces.
sentences.zh: 我们现在几乎无法对他的状况或他未来面临的境遇做出任何评价。

sentences.en: Anton, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 安东，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, President Biden ordered U.S.
sentences.zh: 周三，拜登总统下令美国

sentences.en: intelligence agencies to investigate the origins of the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 情报机构调查新冠病毒的起源。

sentences.en: Today, the president asked the intelligence community to redouble their efforts to collect and analyze information that could bring us closer to a definitive conclusion.
sentences.zh: 今天，总统要求情报界加倍努力收集和分析信息，以使我们更接近最终结论。

sentences.en: Reversing his previous position, that such an investigation should be conducted by the World Health Organization.
sentences.zh: 这推翻了他之前的立场，即此类调查应由世界卫生组织进行。

sentences.en: The Times reports that the order indicates that the White House takes seriously the possibility that the virus may have accidentally leaked from a lab in China,
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，该命令表明白宫认真对待病毒可能从中国实验室意外泄漏的可能性，

sentences.en: as well as the prevailing theory that it was transmitted to humans by an animal in a natural setting.
sentences.zh: 以及病毒在自然环境中由动物传播给人类的主流理论。

sentences.en: The WHO seemed to dismiss the lab theory in a report released in March.
sentences.zh: 世卫组织在3月份发布的一份报告中似乎驳回了实验室理论。

sentences.en: But the theory has since drawn new attention, including from prominent researchers.
sentences.zh: 但该理论此后引起了新的关注，包括来自知名研究人员的关注。

sentences.en: Getting to the bottom of the origin of this pandemic will help us understand how to prepare for the next pandemic and the next one.
sentences.zh: 查明这场大流行的起源将有助于我们了解如何为下一次大流行做好准备。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为您准备假期接待客人的相关内容。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全遮光才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 您可以在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何播客平台上找到《Wirecutter秀》。
